studio Basura exists because the most effective advertising doesn't look like advertising at all
posts.body: Rajeev Basu believes some of the most effective advertising doesn’t look like advertising at all. It’s an approach he has applied across more than two decades in the business, from Wieden+Kennedy and Spotify to Maximum Effort, where he worked with Ryan Reynolds on Wrexham AFC. Now, with his own creative studio Basura, Basu is using satire and unconventional ideas to help brands and artists make work designed to earn attention rather than resemble traditional ads.
